text:
DEPARTMENT OF ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE LAB
NATIONAL INSTITUTE OF HIGHER STUDIES
Date: October 24, 2024

To the Graduate Admissions Committee,

I am writing to offer my enthusiastic recommendation for Aditya Verma, who I have mentored as Thesis Advisor & Course Instructor during their study period (2021-2023) at National Institute of Higher Studies.

During this tenure, Aditya Verma demonstrated exceptional mastery in Python, PyTorch, Distributed Systems, Kubernetes. In our research laboratory, they led the pivotal development of 'High-Throughput Microservice Architecture for Cloud Streaming', exhibiting remarkable technical intuition, rigorous experimental discipline, and intellectual maturity. Additionally, the candidate maintained an exemplary academic record with a GPA of 9.4 / 10.0.

Beyond technical competence, Aditya Verma displays genuine leadership, integrity, and proactive collaboration. I rank Aditya Verma among the top 1% of researchers I have supervised. I strongly recommend them for admission and financial fellowship without reservation.

Warm regards,

Dr. Rajeshwar Rao
Senior Research Director
Artificial Intelligence Lab
National Institute of Higher Studies
Email: .rajeshwar.rao@nationalin.edu
